summary: Wise Group plc filed a Form 6-K attaching its UK Annual Report and supplementary disclosures for UK listing purposes, alongside its Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended 31 March 2026. The filing contains a letter to shareholders reviewing operational and financial progress, including customer growth (+21% YoY to 19 million), cross-border volume (+31% to $243 billion), new licenses in Brazil, Japan, UAE, Thailand, and South Africa, and expanded product features. No transaction, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine annual reporting filing with no deal terms, price, premium, or structural changes.
